title: Pages
empty_description: Pages hold notes, specs and project documents. Create one, or let AI draft it from a title and a prompt.
no_selection_description: Pick a page from the tree on the left, or press “New page” to start one.

generate.prompt_placeholder: Describe what this page should cover, the audience, key sections, tone, and anything else the AI should know.
generate.prompt_help: The page title is used as context and your prompt as the instruction. A new page with this title is created when generation succeeds; titles must be unique.
generate.error: Failed to generate page. Please try again.

description: Write notes, specs and project documents, and organise them in a tree.
parent_hint: Places this page under another page in the tree.
project_hint: Link the page to a project, or keep it for the whole workspace.
ai_generate_hint: Creates a new AI-drafted page from the title and your prompt. Review the text before relying on it.
